## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

List commands and results. Distinguish audio/CLI checks from model integration or quality evaluation. Say if external weights were not used.

## Review notes

- [ ] Changed behavior has a regression test or a clear manual check.
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices are updated where needed.
- [ ] No weights, private recordings, large audio files or credentials are included.
- [ ] Existing outputs remain protected unless `--force` is supplied.
